record.question: Andrew H.Thangliana, who passed away in september, belongs to which profession?
record.explanation: Andrew H. Thangliana was a Mizo journalist and writer who passed away in September 2021. Among the given options (Politician, Musician, Social worker, Journalist), 'Journalist' best describes his profession.
